Retrait du marché et rappel des téléphones AGM Note N1, DOOGEE N55 PLUS, INFINIX SMART 9 (X6532), NOTHING PHONE 3A (A059) à la suite d’un dépassement de la valeur limite de DAS et du téléphones SAMSUNG A55 (SM-A556E/DS) pour défaut de marquage CE.
Korean Summary: 프랑스 통신 규제 기관(ANFR)은 특정 흡수율(SAR) 한도 초과로 인해 AGM Note N1, DOOGEE N55 PLUS, INFINIX SMART 9, NOTHING PHONE 3A 모델에 대한 판매 중단 및 리콜을 명령했습니다. 또한, 삼성 A55 모델은 CE 마킹 누락 및 행정 절차 미준수로 인해 리콜 대상이 되었습니다. 제조업체가 조치를 취하지 않을 경우 유통업체에게도 관련 조치를 요구했습니다.
English Summary: French authorities have ordered the withdrawal and recall of AGM Note N1, DOOGEE N55 PLUS, INFINIX SMART 9, and NOTHING PHONE 3A devices due to exceeding the Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) limits. Additionally, the SAMSUNG A55 is being recalled for a lack of CE marking and administrative non-conformities. Distributors are instructed to act if manufacturers fail to do so.

L’ANFR publie son rapport d’activité 2025
Korean Summary: 프랑스 국립 주파수 관리국(ANFR)은 2025년 활동 보고서를 발표했으며, 이는 디지털, 우주 및 통신 분야의 중요한 변화의 해를 강조합니다. 이 보고서는 기관의 임무, 주요 성과 및 주파수 관리의 미래를 형성하는 전략적 과제를 자세히 설명합니다.
English Summary: The French National Frequency Agency (ANFR) has released its 2025 activity report, highlighting a year of significant transformation in digital, space, and telecommunications. The report outlines the agency's missions, key achievements, and the strategic challenges shaping the future of frequency management.
Read original →
Mise à jour du routeur wifi UBIQUITI LiteAP AC GPS à la suite du constat d’un non-respect des conditions d’utilisation de fréquences radioélectriques
Korean Summary: 프랑스 주파수 관리국(ANFR)은 Ubiquiti Networks Inc.가 무선 주파수 사용 조건을 준수하지 않은 LiteAP AC GPS 와이파이 라우터를 업데이트했다고 발표했습니다. 검사 결과 해당 라우터가 규정을 준수하지 않았으나, 소프트웨어 업데이트를 통해 문제가 해결되어 무선 스펙트럼 사용이 적합하게 되었습니다. ANFR은 특히 기상 레이더와의 간섭을 방지하기 위해 사용자들에게 이 업데이트를 설치할 것을 권고합니다.
English Summary: The French National Frequency Agency (ANFR) announces that Ubiquiti Networks Inc. has updated its LiteAP AC GPS wifi router to correct non-compliance with radio frequency usage conditions. Inspections found the router to be non-compliant, but a software update has resolved the issue, ensuring compliant use of the radio spectrum. The ANFR advises users to install this update to prevent interference with weather radars, among other risks.
Read original →
Exposition aux ondes : l’ANFR publie les résultats 2025 des contrôles de surveillance du marché des terminaux mobiles
Korean Summary: 2025년 프랑스 국립주파수기관(ANFR)은 전자파 노출 한도(SAR) 준수 여부를 확인하기 위해 80개의 모바일 기기를 검사했습니다. 9개 기기는 사지 및 머리 SAR에서 규제 한도를 초과했으며, 8개는 행정적 부적합 사항을 보였습니다. 17개 모델은 소프트웨어 업데이트부터 시장 철수까지 시정 조치가 필요했습니다.
English Summary: In 2025, the French National Frequencies Agency (ANFR) tested 80 mobile devices for compliance with electromagnetic wave exposure limits (SAR). Nine devices exceeded regulatory limits, specifically for limb and head SAR, while eight had administrative non-conformities. Seventeen models required corrective actions, ranging from software updates to market withdrawal.
Read original →
Retrait du marché et rappel du téléphone NUBIA Z70 ULTRA – NX733J à la suite d’un dépassement de la valeur limite de DAS
Korean Summary: 프랑스 ANFR(국립주파수청)은 NUBIA Z70 ULTRA – NX733J 휴대전화가 "사지" 비흡수율(SAR) 한도를 초과하여 프랑스 시장에서 철수 및 회수 명령을 내렸습니다. GOLDEN STREAM 사는 시정 조치를 취해야 하며, 이를 이행하지 않을 경우 유통업체들이 자체적으로 해당 기기들의 철수 및 회수를 진행해야 합니다. 이 조치는 전자파 노출로부터 대중을 보호하기 위함입니다.
English Summary: The ANFR has ordered the withdrawal and recall of the NUBIA Z70 ULTRA – NX733J phone from the French market due to exceeding the "limb" Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) limit. GOLDEN STREAM is required to take corrective actions, and if they fail to do so, distributors must initiate the withdrawal and recall themselves. This measure ensures public protection against electromagnetic wave exposure.
Read original →
Atelier des fréquences #13 : la connectivité spatiale directe vers les mobiles (D2D)
Korean Summary: 제13회 ANFR 주파수 워크숍은 모바일 직접 위성 연결(D2D) 프로젝트와 진행 중인 국제, 유럽, 국내 규제 프레임워크를 검토했습니다. Satellite Connect Europe, Univity, Orange와 같은 주요 이해관계자들이 비전과 파트너십을 발표하며 위성 사업자를 위한 별도 주파수 대역으로의 전환 추세를 강조했습니다. 목표는 D2D 위성 사용을 조화시키고 이러한 신흥 서비스를 위한 국제 규제 프레임워크를 수립하는 것입니다.
English Summary: The 13th ANFR Frequency Workshop reviewed Direct-to-Device (D2D) satellite connectivity projects and ongoing international, European, and national regulatory frameworks. Key stakeholders including Satellite Connect Europe, Univity, and Orange presented their visions and partnerships, highlighting a trend towards distinct frequency bands for satellite operators. The goal is to harmonize D2D satellite usage and establish an international regulatory framework for these emerging services.
Read original →

De plus, le téléphone SAMSUNG A55 est rappelé pour défaut de marquage CE et non-conformités administratives. Les distributeurs sont priés de prendre des mesures en cas d'inaction des fabricants.

articles.title: L’ANFR publie son rapport d’activité 2025
articles.summary_fr: L'Agence Nationale des Fréquences (ANFR) a publié son rapport d'activité pour l'année 2025, soulignant une période de transformation significative dans les domaines du numérique, du spatial et des télécommunications. Ce rapport détaille les missions de l'agence, ses réalisations marquantes, ainsi que les enjeux stratégiques qui orientent la gestion des fréquences pour l'avenir.

articles.title: Mise à jour du routeur wifi UBIQUITI LiteAP AC GPS à la suite du constat d’un non-respect des conditions d’utilisation de fréquences radioélectriques
articles.summary_fr: L'Agence nationale des fréquences (ANFR) annonce que Ubiquiti Networks Inc. a mis à jour son routeur wifi LiteAP AC GPS pour corriger un non-respect des conditions d'utilisation des fréquences radioélectriques. Des contrôles ont révélé que le routeur n'était pas conforme, mais une mise à jour logicielle a résolu le problème, assurant une utilisation conforme du spectre radioélectrique. L'ANFR recommande aux utilisateurs d'installer cette mise à jour pour éviter notamment des brouillages de radars météorologiques.

articles.title: Exposition aux ondes : l’ANFR publie les résultats 2025 des contrôles de surveillance du marché des terminaux mobiles
articles.summary_fr: En 2025, l'ANFR a contrôlé 80 équipements mobiles pour leur conformité aux limites d'exposition aux ondes électromagnétiques (DAS). Neuf terminaux ont dépassé les limites réglementaires, notamment pour le DAS membre et tête, tandis que huit présentaient des non-conformités administratives. Dix-sept modèles ont nécessité des mesures correctives, allant de mises à jour logicielles au retrait du marché.
articles.summary_en: In 2025, the French National Frequencies Agency (ANFR) tested 80 mobile devices for compliance with electromagnetic wave exposure limits (SAR). Nine devices exceeded regulatory limits, specifically for limb and head SAR, while eight had administrative non-conformities. Seventeen models required corrective actions, ranging from software updates to market withdrawal.

articles.title: Retrait du marché et rappel du téléphone NUBIA Z70 ULTRA – NX733J à la suite d’un dépassement de la valeur limite de DAS
articles.summary_fr: L'ANFR a ordonné le retrait et le rappel du téléphone NUBIA Z70 ULTRA – NX733J du marché français en raison de dépassements de la limite de débit d'absorption spécifique (DAS) "membre". La société GOLDEN STREAM est tenue de prendre des mesures correctives, faute de quoi les distributeurs devront procéder au retrait et au rappel des appareils de leur propre initiative. Ce contrôle vise à garantir la protection du public contre l'exposition aux ondes électromagnétiques.
articles.summary_en: The ANFR has ordered the withdrawal and recall of the NUBIA Z70 ULTRA – NX733J phone from the French market due to exceeding the "limb" Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) limit. GOLDEN STREAM is required to take corrective actions, and if they fail to do so, distributors must initiate the withdrawal and recall themselves. This measure ensures public protection against electromagnetic wave exposure.

articles.title: Atelier des fréquences #13 : la connectivité spatiale directe vers les mobiles (D2D)
articles.summary_fr: Le 13ème Atelier des fréquences de l'ANFR a fait le point sur les projets de connectivité spatiale directe vers les mobiles (D2D) et les cadres réglementaires internationaux, européens et nationaux en cours. Des représentants d'acteurs clés comme Satellite Connect Europe, Univity et Orange ont présenté leurs visions et leurs partenariats, soulignant l'évolution vers des bandes de fréquences distinctes pour les opérateurs satellitaires. L'objectif est d'harmoniser l'utilisation des satellites D2D et d'établir un cadre réglementaire international pour ces services émergents.
articles.summary_en: The 13th ANFR Frequency Workshop reviewed Direct-to-Device (D2D) satellite connectivity projects and ongoing international, European, and national regulatory frameworks. Key stakeholders including Satellite Connect Europe, Univity, and Orange presented their visions and partnerships, highlighting a trend towards distinct frequency bands for satellite operators. The goal is to harmonize D2D satellite usage and establish an international regulatory framework for these emerging services.
